answer.what_it_does: PI Industries Ltd is a science-led, innovation-driven life sciences company operating in agrisciences, custom synthesis and manufacturing, biologicals, and specialty chemicals. It provides integrated crop solutions, active ingredients, formulations, and pharmaceutical CRDMO services globally.

segments.name: Agro Chemicals
segments.note: Active ingredients, formulations and Custom Synthesis and Manufacturing.

segments.name: Pharma
segments.note: Pharma CRDMO, discovery and development services.

answer.customers: Serves over 1.6 million farmers via 15,000+ distributors in India and long-term global innovator partners.

facts.fact: PI employs over 700 scientists and 200+ PhDs across R&D facilities.
Domestic agribusiness serves over 1.6 million farmers across 45,000 villages.
Consolidated revenue of 67,137 million in FY26.
Total permanent employees and workers stand at 3,840 on a consolidated basis.

answer.geography: Operates globally with revenue from India, Asia, North America, Europe, and Rest of the World.
answer.revenue_mix_basis: Share of revenue from operations for the year ended March 31, 2026 based on segment reporting.

risks.risk: Geopolitical and macroeconomic risks affecting trade flows, supply chains, and inflation.
R&D, technology and competitive risks including potential delays or failures in product development.
Foreign exchange and working capital risks from global transactions and seasonal demand.
Environmental, social and governance risks regarding compliance and stakeholder expectations.
